name: openbb_currency_snapshots
description:
Snapshot of current exchange rates against a base currency (USD by OpenBB's default) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.currency.snapshots).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp or polygon; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
One pair: av_forex_rate; history: openbb_forex_historical, yf_forex_history. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "fmp"}
